quotes.text: Your API versioning should be boring and predictable. If it's exciting, something's wrong.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: I've been doing meaningless version bumps — no real changes, or no changes that applied to Gentoo — just so our packages don't get reported as "outdated." It's a hassle and it sucks, but it saves people from worrying.
quotes.author: hypfer
quotes.source: Hacker News — The next circle of security hell
quotes.extraction_note: Confession about fake version bumps to appease ecosystem dashboards — very real, self-deprecating, and exposes a broken industry dynamic.
